title: Make the wave taller
hook: Change wave amplitude and predict wave intensity.
misconception: wave intensity doubles when wave amplitude doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply I ∝ A² to compare wave intensity when wave amplitude changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a linear wave with fixed frequency medium and other parameters, I ∝ A². When wave amplitude doubles, wave intensity becomes 4 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model I ∝ A²; scaling exponent 2. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a linear wave with fixed frequency medium and other parameters, with a nonzero initial result. If wave amplitude triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on wave intensity?
recall.why: Apply I ∝ A² under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 9.
